name: Wear the Rune-laden Scales and stand fast against a magical attack

system.description: When you **_wear the Rune-laden Scales and stand fast against a magical attack_**, roll +CON: **on a 10+**, the magic washes over you, unpleasant perhaps but with no ill effect; **on a 7-9**, you’re only partially affected—suffer half damage (if any) and a reduced effect; **on a 6-**, mark XP, and the magic affects you fully.

success.value: the magic washes over you, unpleasant perhaps but with no ill effect

partial.value: you’re only partially affected—suffer half damage (if any) and a reduced effect

failure.value: mark XP, and the magic affects you fully.
